answer_1.quote: We examine the bias of GPT-2 text generation against AAVE features... we prompt GPT-2 with the first segments of each AAVE/SAE pair. The generated text is compared to its corresponding original second segment by BLEU, ROUGE, and sentiment scores.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU, ROUGE, and sentiment scores... BLEU-1, 2, and 3 are the cumulative ... ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L... DistilBERT, VADER, TextBlob sentiment classifiers are employed to evaluate sentiment.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation using AMT to assess the quality of the text generated by GPT-2... Annotators were asked to choose which one of the two generated phrases better fits the context of the respective first segment, which one has better quality, and which one is most likely machine-generated.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose which generated phrase better fits the context, which has better quality, and which is most likely machine-generated (ties allowed).
